description: API-shape experiment for rendering any part of a song offline (a session scene repeated, a scene chain, a pattern), exporting WAV files, and reading live track levels. Expectations describe behaviour, not names.

tasks.prompt: A browser groovebox has an open song as `project` (4/4, 120 BPM) and its running engine as `workspace`. The song is built only in the session grid: scenes named A, B and C, each with clips on Drums and Bass, and nothing on the arrangement timeline. Write the code for two export buttons. "Export loop" renders scene B played four times in a row, offline through the same mix the user hears (volumes, mutes, effects), and downloads it as a 16-bit stereo WAV file. "Export song" renders the chain A, A, B, C (each scene once, back to back on bar lines) the same way and downloads it as a WAV file. Report each render's length in seconds and its peak level. Neither export may change the song or interrupt what is playing.
tasks.hostDeclarations:
declare const project: import("@audiorective/daw").Project;
declare const workspace: import("@audiorective/daw").Workspace;
expectations: Renders scene B four times offline through the song's mix without hand-building a second project or engine.
Renders the chain A, A, B, C offline, each scene starting on a bar line, without hand-building a second project or engine.
Encodes each render as a 16-bit stereo WAV without hand-writing a RIFF/WAV encoder.
Reports each render's length in seconds and its peak level.
Leaves the song unchanged and playback uninterrupted.

tasks.prompt: A browser DAW has an open song as `project` and its running engine as `workspace`, with several audio and MIDI tracks. Write the code for its mixer meters: while the song plays, every track strip and the master strip show a live peak level in dBFS (updated about 30 times a second) and a peak-hold value that resets when clicked; meters fall to silence when playback stops; they keep working after tracks are added or the project is reopened. Also add an "Export bars 1–8" button that renders bars 1 to 8 of the arrangement offline through the mix and downloads a 24-bit WAV file.
tasks.hostDeclarations:
declare const project: import("@audiorective/daw").Project;
declare const workspace: import("@audiorective/daw").Workspace;
expectations: Reads each track's live level from the engine without wiring its own AnalyserNode to internal audio nodes.
Reads the master level the same way.
Updates the meters about 30 times a second and shows peak-hold that resets on click.
Meters keep working after tracks are added or the project is reopened, and fall to silence when stopped.
Renders bars 1–8 of the arrangement offline through the mix.
Downloads it as a 24-bit WAV without hand-writing a RIFF/WAV encoder.
